notes: IDMToken is a fixed-supply ERC-20 with no constructor arguments. Its constructor mints 1,000,000,000 IDM with 18 decimals to msg.sender once. It has no owner, subsequent minting, transfer fees or privileged controls. No application contracts or initialization calls are required. pool.initialPrice is provenance only; the deployer derives the opening price from economics.initialMarketCapWei and totalSupply.
